segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Hi Aaron,

We’re ready to move ahead for 68 seats, go-live target March 18. Please send the order form for annual billing and net 30.

Maya

segments.speaker: Aaron Lee, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

Great. I’ll draft it today with 68 seats, March 18 start, 12-month term, annual invoice, net 30.

The standard total from the pricing sheet is $81,600 before tax. I’ll send for signature once I have the final address and billing contact.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Aaron,

Billing contact is Greg Nunez, ap@northbayfoods.com. Address is 1440 Harbor Drive, Oakland, CA 94607.

One issue: $81,600 is higher than what we discussed. In your text Friday you said you could do $72,900 if we signed this week.

Maya

segments.speaker: Aaron Lee, Rep
segments.text:
Maya,

Yes, that’s the number I gave you over text. To be direct, I can hold $72,900 for the 68 seats if you can sign by Friday. That discount normally has to go through deal desk because it’s below the pricing sheet, but I don’t want to slow this down. I’ll send the order form at $72,900 now and sort the approval paperwork afterward on my side.

Everything else stays the same: annual billing, net 30, March 18 start.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Okay, thanks for confirming.

Please make sure the order form shows $72,900 as the full-year subscription total, not a first-year credit or rebate. Finance will reject it if the invoice doesn’t match the signed amount.

Maya

segments.speaker: Aaron Lee, Rep
segments.text:
Understood.

I’ll list it as the annual subscription total for 68 seats: $72,900. No rebate language. I’ll also add the March 18 start date and net 30 terms.

Aaron

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Good. Send it to me and copy Greg. We can sign by Thursday afternoon if the tax amount is included.

Maya

segments.speaker: Aaron Lee, Rep
segments.text:
Attached.

Order form includes:
- 68 seats
- 12-month term starting March 18
- Annual subscription total $72,900
- Estimated tax $6,014.25
- Net 30 invoice terms

Greg is copied.

Aaron
